test_title: PYST 67: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the given letter series.

B_ E N B_ C E N B B C_ N B B C E_ B_ C
solution:
Given series: B_ E N B_ C E N B B C_ N B B C E_ B_ C

Option 1) BCENB → B__B__ E N B__C__ C E N B B C__E__ N B B C E__N__ B__B__ C → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) BNECB → B__B__ E N B__N__ C E N B B C__E__ N B B C E__C__ B__B__ C → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) CNEBB → B__C__ E N B__N__ C E N B B C__E__ N B B C E__B__ B__B__ C → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) CBENB → B__**C**__ E N B__**B**__ C E N B B C__**E**__ N B B C E__**N**__ B__**B**__ C → (It follows the pattern of: BCENB - BCENB - BCENB - BCENB - BC)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
